subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'MOSQUE' is written as '92', 'TEMPLE' is written as '111', how will 'CHURCH' be written in that language?
solution:
The positional value table is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/889ff2be8a048327f450a975a401b2f4241e5f28d86896613386ad4014cb4505.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

**Coded word = (Sum of opposite positional values) + 20**

 
• In MOSQUE → 92 
 
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5ac8fb68b1785ac92cb47a6a0334fd68d95a3797bff47bbb9f0fc821f10b0760.png] 
 
• Sum of opposite positional values = 14 + 12 + 8 + 10 + 6 + 22 = 72
 
• Coded word = 72 + 20 = 92
 
 

 

 
• In TEMPLE → 111 ​

 
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/52a645f45d4282a3f04959e01c2012394bbfa98498c34ccbd555a8fc89cce8e5.png] 
 
• Sum of opposite positional values = 7 + 22 + 14 + 11 + 15 + 22 = 91
 
• Coded word = 91 + 20 = 111
 
 

 

 
• Similarly, In CHURCH → ​

 
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/29856d5457a29afbfc562eafde82e47362fba0c9e2d75f8452792214ebb40faf.png] 
 
• Sum of opposite positional values = 24 + 19 + 6 + 9 + 24 + 19 = 101
 
• Coded word = 101 + 20 = **121**
 
 

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
